worldcombat.skill.happyhour.summary: Throw a small celebration and lay a ring of golden hours under yourself; for its duration every non-ally that falls inside drops a burst of Relic Coins that would otherwise settle after the battle.
The banner lasts %1$s s with a %2$s block radius; the ring you see is the area it senses.
Each non-ally that falls inside drops %1$s relic coins on the spot (Cobblemon relic coins when available).
worldcombat.skill.happyhour.lavish.on: Lavish: x1.4 per payout and x1.15 radius, at x0.8 banner and x1.15 cooldown, for making a hard fight pay big.
worldcombat.skill.happyhour.lavish.off: Long show: the banner at its base value and x0.95 cooldown, with slightly smaller payouts and radius, for steady business.
worldcombat.skill.happyhour.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %5$s PP, cooldown %4$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.happyhour.growth.0: From level %1$s the banner rises to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.happyhour.growth.1: From level %1$s each payout rises to %2$s, the radius to %3$s blocks and the banner to %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.happyhour.use.0: Lay it down before a hard fight and turn the kills into a harvest
worldcombat.skill.happyhour.use.1: Hold a chokepoint so every foe that falls there pays a toll
worldcombat.skill.happyhour.use.2: Add field income to a long team grind
worldcombat.skill.happyhour.preference.l: On: x1.4 per payout and x1.15 radius, at x0.8 banner and x1.15 cooldown, for one big harvest. Off: the banner at its base value and x0.95 cooldown, with slightly smaller payouts and radius.
worldcombat.skill.happyhour.preference.a: Only lay the celebration when a threat is this close; larger sets it up further out.
Only celebrate with at least this many non-allies in the radius; lower sets it up for a single foe too.
On: also leave a hold position to lay the celebration.
world_combat.move.happyhour.text.raise: Happy Hour: foes falling in %1$s s each leave %2$s relic coins
